text: Cold recipe reconstruction must bind expected-unmatched rules against the verified saved pre-admission inventory ledger. It already retains declared attributes and absent/quarantined trial identities; inferring membership from admitted keys would change the scientific selection. NativeArtifactPackage.verify now passes ledger.inventory to RealPlan.plan, preserving recipe/facts/plan/result identity. CSV label domains include by-design so emitted classifications retain missing scores and reasons. No schema, digest algorithm, default budget or numerical estimator changed.
